headline: Bumble goes from takeover talks to a $1.3 billion acquisition deal
summary: Bumble's shares rose on a report of roughly $1 billion takeover talks, pushing its market valuation above $580m but still far below its $14bn peak. Bumble has now agreed to a $1.3 billion acquisition, following years of declining subscribers and falling revenue at the dating app.
